exposure: Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) diagnosis by WHO 1999 criteria
Gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) diagnosis by IADPSG criteria
cohort: 1508 women who underwent a 75-g OGTT after the 24th week of gestation at the University Hospital of Bialystok between 2004 and 2012
finding: The introduction of the IADPSG criteria for diagnosing gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM) did not increase the prevalence of GDM overall but identified more cases with isolated fasting hyperglycemia compared to the WHO 1999 criteria.
